checks.name: n111_mobile_delete_confirmation_first_tap_exactly_once
checks.evidence: 390x844 touch context, real account UI/store/owner guard and source CSS: one tap executes exactly one guarded commit despite suppressed compatibility click. While receipt held, duplicate clicks ignored, dialog retained, no Product rows changed. ACK tombstones only selected class/item/score; other grades, students, history and outbox unchanged. Back/cancel, touchcancel and drag remain read-only.
